find: if (Math.abs(nv) >= Math.abs(err)) return { angle: target, vel: 0 };
replace: if (Math.abs(nv) >= Math.abs(err) && false) return { angle: target, vel: 0 };
why: Without the clamp the final tick of a sweep lands PAST the target and the turret has to come back, which reads as a wobble on every arrival rather than a stop. The `&& false` keeps both operands evaluated so a tsc error cannot stand in for a real test failure.
killedBy: accelSlew a target that jumps BEHIND a fast-moving turret is arrived at, not overshot -- and the discarded velocity is bounded by the speed cap, not the acceleration budget
accelSlew arrives ON the target instead of sailing past it, and stops there
accelSlew reaches the speed cap on a long sweep and never exceeds it
